description: Calculate single-qubit average fidelity under Markovian amplitude/phase damping using Nielsen (2002). Accept T1, T2 or Tphi and gate time; checks T2 <= 2T1 and returns pure dephasing, error per gate and an independent-error depth proxy, not a circuit-success guarantee.

mode.description: Whether t2_us denotes T2 or Tphi; default t2.

success.description: Target success proxy P (0 to 1); default 0.99.

name: qubit_coherence
title: Qubit coherence and gate fidelity calculator
